name: TF3I San Diego 2017
information:
* **The cost of registration is a $15 flat fee. Payments are taken after registering. We will not be taking registrations or payments at the door.**
* Registration closes October 28th at 11:59 PM PDT, or earlier if we reach the 150 competitor limit.
* Spectating is free and open the the public. Photography and videography are permitted, however there shall be **NO FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY.**
* Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years - thanks!
